entities.name: Altanak
entities.description: A massive insectoid fusion of human and insect flesh on Duskmourn, one of Valgavoth's earliest experiments, summoned by saying its name three times.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The malign power of the House who created Altanak.

events.summary: Altanak is created as one of Valgavoth's earliest experiments during the rise of the House.
events.quote: Altanak is a fusion of human and insect flesh, one of Valgavoth 's earliest experiments during the rise of the House .

events.summary: Survivors who speak Altanak's name too often may be hunted by it.
events.quote: Survivors who dare to speak the name too often may soon find themselves hunted by Altanak itself

relations.note: Altanak was one of his earliest experiments.
relations.quote: one of Valgavoth 's earliest experiments during the rise of the House
